title: Velocity at A
description: Essential: Correctly calculates v₀ = √(3gR) using energy conservation between A and B.

title: Height after C
description: Essential: Correctly determines maximum height after C as 3.5R using energy conservation.

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Important: Applies mechanical energy conservation correctly, identifying gravitational potential energy at different heights.

title: Velocity direction at A
description: Important: Recognizes that velocity at A is directed downward along the track.

title: Height reference consistency
description: Important: Uses consistent reference point (lowest point or ground) for potential energy calculations.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: Shows clear algebraic steps to solve for unknowns from energy equations.

title: Unit awareness
description: Optional: Recognizes that answers have correct dimensions (velocity and length).

title: Sign error in energy
description: Pitfall: Makes sign error in gravitational potential energy terms (e.g., using wrong height differences).

title: Incorrect velocity formula
description: Pitfall: Uses kinematics (v² = u² + 2as) instead of energy conservation on curved track.

title: Confusion about height after C
